title: CRUCIBLE
description: A semi-anarchy Economy SMP inspired by DonutSMP, featuring a fully-fledged player-driven economy with shops, auctions, spawners, and a bounty system. PvP, griefing, and scamming are all fair game — trust no one, build your empire.
body:
# Crucible

A semi-anarchy Economy SMP inspired by DonutSMP. Build your wealth, dominate the market, and eliminate your competition — Crucible has no rules, only winners and losers.

---

## World
- Open world with no land claiming or protection
- Griefing, raiding, and scamming are permitted
- Spawn is protected — everything beyond it is fair game

---

## Economy
- **Player Shops** — set up your own chest shop anywhere in the world
- **Auction House** — list and bid on items across the entire server
- **Admin Shop** — convert your loot into cash at /warp shop
- **Dual Currency** — earn Money through trading and Shards through PvP
- **Crates** — redeem Shards for randomized high-value rewards

---

## PvP
- Open PvP across the entire map outside of spawn
- **Bounty System** — place bounties on players, collect on kills
- **Duels** — structured 1v1 combat with optional monetary wager
- **Combat Logging** — disconnecting mid-fight results in automatic death
- **Teams** — form alliances to control territory and dominate rivals

---

## Progression
- **Spawners** — automate resource generation for passive income
- **Leaderboards** — global rankings for wealth, kills, and playtime
- **Daily Rewards** — consecutive login bonuses with escalating value

---

## Rules
- Hacking, exploiting, and cheating are strictly prohibited
- Griefing, scamming, and PvP are fully permitted
- Spawn zone is a no-PvP, no-grief safe area

---

*Build. Grind. Dominate.*
